candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement 'balances[msg.sender]=0;' so balances are not zeroed after withdrawal, leaving a nonzero balance observable after withdraw completes.
Replace 'balances[msg.sender]=0;' with 'balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;' so the withdrawn amount is added back instead of zeroing the balance.

Delete the statement '__lock_modifier0_lock = true;' from the modifier, removing the reentrancy guard so a reentrant call during the external call can double-withdraw and change balances at the attacker's key.
Move the zeroing of the balance before the external call, so on reentrancy the caller sees a zero balance during the callback.
Delete the require check on the call's success, so a failed ETH transfer no longer reverts and the balance is still zeroed.
Delete the lock reset after the function body, so the mutex stays set and every subsequent withdraw call reverts.
Delete the lock acquisition check, removing the reentrancy guard so a reentrant withdraw during the external call can succeed.
